generation.raw_text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Fish and frogs produce a huge number of eggs each year because they undergo external fertilization. In this process, the female lays a large number of eggs in water, and the male releases millions of sperms over them. Since fertilization occurs outside the body and is controlled by natural conditions, producing a vast number of eggs and sperms increases the chances of successful fertilization.","selected_evidence_ids":["E1"],"citations":[{"evidence_id":"E1","pdf_page":139,"textbook_page":130}],"missing_information":[]}
